Apple TV (now $6.99/month for Black Friday) has a new season of hit comedy Bad Monkey coming next week from Bill Lawrence, co-creator of Ted Lasso and Shrinking. Here’s what Lawrence says to expect from Bad Monkey season 2.

Bad Monkey season 2 coming next week, here’s what to expect per co-creator Bill Lawrence

Among Apple TV comedies, three of the best share one creative force behind them: Bill Lawrence.

Ted Lasso, Shrinking, and Bad Monkey were all co-created by Lawrence and continue to be among the most beloved series at Apple. But out of the three, Bad Monkey is easily the least known.

Anyone who watches Apple TV has at least heard of Ted Lasso. And Shrinking was Apple’s most watched show for much of this year. While the Vince Vaughn-starring Bad Monkey was a hit when it premiered in 2024, it’s poised for a bigger return in season 2.

Bad Monkey season 2 arrives next Wednesday, December 2 with its first episode, and you can catch up by watching season 1 here.

Recently Bill Lawrence gave an interview to Esquire where he shared what to expect from the new season. Here are some spoiler-free highlights:

  • John Malkovich’s role: “This story started from a place of [thinking], If John Malkovich was kind and silly enough to bring him in this world, who would he be? You will meet him as our other fearless leader this year.”
  • Upgraded action: “The one thing we wanted to upgrade in season 2 is the action. It’s stuff I haven’t shot in my normal 30-minute comedies before, and I think we pulled it off.”
  • More character deaths: “One of the things about Carl’s books is that when you reach the end, a lot of the regulars have died. Knowing the cast will never get too big, it’s fun to see the smoke clear and [find out] who’s left.”

This summer brought the long-awaited return of Ted Lasso for season 4. And early next year will bring a fourth season of Shrinking too. For anyone who wants another Lawrence fix, I highly recommend checking out Bad Monkey.

Apple TV is available for just $6.99/ month (over 50% off) for Black Friday. The discounted price lasts for up to six months.
